calls.title: Compare pages restructure
calls.summary:
# Compare pages restructure
Date: 2026-11-13 | Duration: 56m

## Summary
The discussion focused on improving the initial page experience while preserving existing content. The page should begin with a clearer narrative and short summary before presenting deeper details, while retaining the at-a-glance table covering audience and setup information with better readability and scanning. Competitive messaging under consideration includes cost, developer friendliness, and warehouse-native architecture, alongside product-team positioning around open source, self-hosted deployment, and easy technology-stack integration. The cost message should emphasize predictable pricing and a significantly cheaper position. Customer value should also highlight direct engineering access and experimentation expertise. Battle cards, pricing-page language, and FAQ content will provide source material, although battle cards need more customer-ready phrasing. Karen will draft a revised Figma page structure, Ashley will refine the battle-card format, and Emmy will schedule a three-person review next week.

## Keywords
Competitive comparison pages, GrowthBook, Optimizely, Battle cards, Warehouse-native experimentation, Progressive disclosure

## Action Items
**Emmy Sharp**
Discuss comparison-page content (06:54)
Schedule follow-up review (54:17)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Develop battle-card format (12:21)

Create Figma concept (52:05)
